# Pan-cancer immune-subtype analysis (`pancancer299`) — main-text Fig. 5a

To characterize immune-associated differential selection at the pan-cancer level,
we pooled tumor samples across cancer types (**8,253 tumors across 27 TCGA cancer
types**) rather than analyzing each tumor type separately. Starting from the 299
driver genes of Bailey et al., each gene was tested for differential selection
between each immune subtype and all remaining subtypes (Thorsson **C1–C4,
one-vs-rest**), adjusting for patient age, sex, and tumor type (sex dropped for
single-sex cohorts, tumor type for single-tumor cohorts). The Benjamini–Hochberg
FDR was computed separately across all genes **within each immune subtype**.

Pipeline (see `code/`): `run_cohort_multi.R` / `recover_cohort.R` run the 299
gene-cohorts on the cluster; `aggregate_pancancer299.R` combines the per-cohort
C1–C4 results into `data/pancancer299_immune_aggregated.txt` (one row per
gene × subtype; the BH FDR is `p.adjust(dd.p, "fdr")` within each subtype).

```{r pancancer299-fig5a}
suppressMessages(library(data.table))
agg <- fread("data/pancancer299_immune_aggregated.txt")
n_genes   <- length(unique(agg$gene))
sig       <- agg[dd.fdr < 0.1]
sig_genes <- sort(unique(sig$gene))
cat("Driver genes tested:", n_genes, "\n")
cat("Genes with FDR < 0.1 in >=1 immune subtype:", length(sig_genes),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)\n", 100 * length(sig_genes) / n_genes))
cat("Significant genes:", paste(sig_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

This reproduces the main-text number: **18 of 220 driver genes (8.2%)** show
differential selection across immune subtypes (Fig. 5a). The significant
gene × immune-subtype associations:

```{r pancancer299-table}
library(DT)
datatable(
  sig[, .(gene, subtype = phenotype, dd.p = signif(dd.p, 3),
          dd.fdr = signif(dd.fdr, 3), direction, mut_freq)][order(subtype, dd.fdr)],
  extensions = 'Buttons',
  options = list(dom = 'Bfrtip',
                 buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel'), pageLength = 20)
)
```

# Per-tumor-type immune-subtype analysis (earlier version)

The analysis below tests immune subtypes **within each tumor type separately**
(an earlier version superseded by the pooled pan-cancer analysis above for the
main text). In total, **80 analyses** were conducted across **20 tumor types**,
each classified into **4 distinct immune phenotype groups (C1–C4)**. Among these
analyses, **70 completed successfully**, while **10 encountered errors**. The
specific tumor type and phenotype combinations for unsuccessful analyses are
detailed below.

# Extracting and Summarizing Analysis Results

```{r legacy-data-guard, include=FALSE}

# where that data is mounted; otherwise they are skipped so the page still builds.
# The main-text Fig. 5a result (pancancer299) above is reproduced from committed data.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = dir.exists("/Volumes/Szhao/qiruiz/diffdriver/temp/output/new_plot/immunesubtypes") || dir.exists("/dartfs/rc/lab/S/Szhao/qiruiz/diffdriver/temp/output/new_plot/immunesubtypes"))
```

This code segment scans through analysis output directories, identifies relevant result files (*_resdd.Rd), extracts corresponding tumor types and immune phenotypes. Only results from the signature model are included.
```{r}
get_files <- function(outputdir, tumors = NULL, phenotypes = NULL) {
  files <- list.files(
    path = outputdir,
    pattern = "_resdd\\.Rd$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  
  matching_files_txt <- sub("\\.Rd$", ".txt", files)
  
  analysis_mode <- ifelse(grepl("_sig_", basename(files)), "sig", "reg")

  inner_folder_names      <- basename(dirname(files))            
  phenotype_folder_names  <- basename(dirname(dirname(files)))  
  
  tumor_names <- mapply(function(inner_name, phen) {
    pattern_front <- paste0("^", phen, "_")
    tmp <- sub(pattern_front, "", inner_name)
    tmp <- sub("_mutations$", "", tmp)
    return(tmp)
  }, inner_folder_names, phenotype_folder_names)
  
  phenos_all <- phenotype_folder_names
  
  filedf <- data.frame(
    tumor      = tumor_names,
    phenotype  = phenos_all,
    mode       = analysis_mode,   
    file       = files,
    filetxt    = matching_files_txt,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  if (!is.null(tumors)) {
    filedf <- filedf[filedf$tumor %in% tumors, ]
  }
  if (!is.null(phenotypes)) {
    filedf <- filedf[filedf$phenotype %in% phenotypes, ]
  }

  rownames(filedf) <- NULL
  return(filedf)
}

filedf <- get_files(
  outputdir = "/Volumes/Szhao/qiruiz/diffdriver/temp/output/new_plot/immunesubtypes"
)
filedf <- filedf[filedf$mode == "sig", ]
```

# Summary Table of Significant Differential Genes
The provided function extracts and compiles results from analyses, filtering specifically for significant differential genes based on a threshold (**`dd.fdr < 0.1`**).  
```{r}
get_diff_table <- function(filedf, include_nonsig = TRUE){
  pheno_all <- unique(filedf$phenotype)
  numlist <- list()
  
  for (p in pheno_all){
    p_txtfiles <- filedf[filedf$phenotype == p, ]
    numlist[[p]] <- list()
    
    for (t in seq_len(nrow(p_txtfiles))){
      txtf  <- p_txtfiles[t, "filetxt"]
      rdf   <- p_txtfiles[t, "file"] 
      tumor <- p_txtfiles[t, "tumor"] 
      mode  <- p_txtfiles[t, "mode"]     # reg / sig
      
      env <- new.env()
      load(rdf, envir = env)
      res_rdata <- env$res
      
      res <- read.table(txtf, header = TRUE)
      res$gene <- row.names(res)
      res$mode <- mode
      
      res$alpha <- sapply(res$gene, function(gene){
          res_rdata[[gene]][["dd"]][["res.alt"]]$alpha[2]
      })
      
      res$significant <- res$dd.fdr < 0.1
      
      if (include_nonsig) {
        numlist[[p]][[ paste0(tumor, "_", mode) ]] <- res
      } else {
        sig_res <- res[res$dd.fdr < 0.1, ]
        if (nrow(sig_res) > 0){
          numlist[[p]][[ paste0(tumor, "_", mode) ]] <- sig_res
        }
      }
    }
    
    if (length(numlist[[p]]) == 0){
      numlist[[p]] <- NULL
    }
  }
  
  combined_df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(names(numlist), function(pheno) {
      numlist.pheno <- numlist[[pheno]]
      df.pheno <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(numlist.pheno), function(tname) {
        df <- numlist.pheno[[tname]]
        df$tumor <- sub("_.*", "", tname) 
        df$mode  <- sub(".*_", "", tname) 
        return(df)
      }))
      df.pheno$pheno <- pheno
      return(df.pheno)
    })
  )
  return(combined_df)
}

diff_table_all <- get_diff_table(filedf, include_nonsig = TRUE)
diff_table <-  get_diff_table(filedf, include_nonsig = FALSE)
```
